verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own agent, Neo, is described as taking plain-English requests and then handling dependencies, executing changes, and monitoring outcomes automatically. The MCP server can also delegate tasks to Neo, which suggests agent work can run without the user driving each step. The Automation API is only an SDK building block for constructing such automation, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented scheduled or triggered background automations (e.g., recurring jobs or event-driven runs), details on how autonomous Neo runs are configured and supervised, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
